Card Q&A.q: I used this card and placed it in the trash. Can I then activate this card's {Trash} [End of Your Turn] effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it can be activated. You can have your Digimon attack without suspending even if you can't trash a security card.
Card Q&A.q: I have 0 security cards. Can I activate this card's {Trash} [End of Your Turn] effect?
If I use this card's {Trash} [End of Your Turn] effect to attack, can that Digimon attack even if it's suspended?

Effect: While you have a Digimon with [Lucemon] in its name on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.

{Trash} [End of Your Turn] If you have a Digimon with [Lucemon] in its name, by returning this card to the bottom of the deck, trash your top security card and 1 of your Digimon attacks without suspending.
[Main] Until your opponent's turn ends, 1 of your Digimon with [Lucemon] in its name gains ＜Raid＞, ＜Piercing＞, ＜Blocker＞ and +3000 DP.
Security Effect: [Security] You may play 1 [Lucemon] from your trash without paying the cost.
